title: Alarms on expliCCit's own encoder: would they have flagged Case Study 1's fault? (R2)
description: experiments/r2_alarms.py for expliCCit's released net1 (third_party/expliccit-models), which states one value per LCF and so has no entropy alarm, beside net1 v6 (model-v6-inputs, seed 0). Thresholds at the 95th percentile on the 30 s broad data's validation links, false alarms on its test links (exp-data-net1-broad-30s-73). Positive families: expliCCit's released policy as deployed (agent_pure) on its two case-study links for 80 s and on the training family's validation links for 30 s (experiments/heldout.py, campaign seed 31), steps kept, so each net1 reads the measurements of expliCCit's own flow; and the cellular episodes of exp-net1v6-cellular-207. A single value is wrong when off by more than a factor of 2, or busy fraction by more than 0.25 (r2_alarms.py, ours).
prepare: uv run expliccit train import-expliccit third_party/expliccit-models "$OUT/expliccit" --as-deployed; P=(--policy "expliccit=$OUT/expliccit/policy.onnx@pure"); for fd in case-studies:80:test training:30:val; do f=${fd%%:*}; r=${fd#*:}; d=${r%:*}; s=${r#*:}; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-$f" --split "$s" --family "$f" --duration-ms "${d}000" --seed 31 --stock "" "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$f/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-$f"; done
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"; done
collect: uv run python experiments/r2_alarms.py "$OUT/alarms" --net1 expliccit=expliccit:third_party/expliccit-models --net1 v6="$IN/m/net1-v6-s0.pt" --calib "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" --negatives "$IN/d30/campaign-train30" --positives case-studies="$OUT/c-case-studies" --positives expliccit-val="$OUT/c-training" --positives cellular="$IN/cell/c-cellular-30"
